interpretation: CDC PLACES reports small-area modeled estimates, not direct county observations or causal program impacts. The 2025 obesity measure uses 2023 BRFSS survey data. CDC explicitly states Kentucky and Pennsylvania did not meet the minimum 2023 BRFSS collection requirements: obesity estimates are unavailable for all 120 Kentucky and 67 Pennsylvania counties (187 missing records; value null, not zero). Other 2,956 counties have published model estimates. CDC official documentation: https://www.cdc.gov/places/current-release-notes/ and https://www.cdc.gov/brfss/annual_data/annual_2023.html. The source vintage 2025 is distinct from health reference 2023.
method: Use CDC PLACES 2025 GIS-friendly county source for the unadjusted adult obesity crude modeled prevalence and reported 95-percent model confidence interval. The obesity estimate uses 2023 BRFSS source responses. No county-wide survey count, interpolation or causal effect is inferred.
publishedSource: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
